status: SIGNED - analysis commit and extension-analysis code digest pinned; extension staging permitted; the one-time truth join waits for the published Zenodo deposit named by zenodo.publication_record

release_pin.analysis_commit_rule: fill with the exact clean paper-repository commit containing this signed amendment, the final analysis code and freeze configuration; then update the Zenodo bundle before signing
release_pin.analysis_code_digest_rule: src/champhla_confirmation/readiness.py:extension_analysis_code_sha256; recomputed identically from a clean git archive of the analysis commit

t1k_correction.schema: validate the documented current nine-column genotype output (eight genotype fields plus secondary_alleles) or the explicit legacy eight-column schema; reject all unknown or malformed schemas
t1k_correction.quality: discard any primary allele whose T1K quality is <=0
t1k_correction.count_one: with num_diff_alleles=1, duplicate exactly one surviving positive-quality primary allele as caller-native homozygosity
t1k_correction.count_two: with num_diff_alleles=2, require two surviving positive-quality primary alleles; one survivor is partial/non-call, never homozygous
t1k_correction.count_zero: accept only a native non-call whose two primary allele triples are placeholders
t1k_correction.secondary_alleles: parse and retain in provenance but never promote to the primary genotype
t1k_correction.failure: contradictory rows, malformed fields, unknown schemas and parser errors fail the workflow task

unchanged_commitments: equal-weight plurality rule and lexicographic tie-break

89-WES/99-RNA frozen subject roster and zero-overlap rule
one-time truth join only after prediction/code/manifest freeze
report the extension regardless of direction
